facts.business: SRU Steels Limited is an Indian listed company operating in the steel industry.

auditor.name: Bihari Shah & Co., Chartered Accountants (FRN No: 119020W)

key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and global trade restrictions
Commodity-price volatility and exchange rate fluctuations
Cheap imports and global overcapacity, particularly from China
Volatility in coking-coal and energy prices
High capital requirements and logistics costs
Environmental regulations and need to reduce carbon emissions
Regulatory compliance delays (e.g., late filing of financial results, delayed disclosures under SEBI LODR)
